correctness.rationale: The exact frontier of K_{2,b} has b edges until the opposite hub is reached; hazard j/b gives the bridge distribution. Once both hubs are reached the remaining parent choices are iid fair, proving the finite law. Product-tail expansion gives Rayleigh scaling; conditional characteristic functions yield an independent normal contribution. Exact UST enumeration and monotone coupling give the strict stochastic comparison. Independent rational frontier-state enumeration agrees for every b=1..9; all infinite statements have analytic arguments.

value.rationale: The designated source degree is a natural observable in a canonical frontier-growth tree model; its exact distribution reveals a birthday-scale discovery phase. The √b-scaled root degree has a non-Gaussian Rayleigh-plus-normal limit in contrast to the Gaussian uniform-spanning-tree law; exact stochastic domination and an explicit √b expectation bias quantify the sampling mechanism. This is structural, not an arbitrary finite parameter increment.
